region.name: Malay Peninsula and Strait of Malacca
region.setting: Humid equatorial land and sea with two monsoon seasons: Peninsular Malaysia, eastern Sumatra and the waters around them. About half of the box is sea.

variable.name: Humidity
variable.definition: Grams of water vapor in each kilogram of air near the ground.

verdict.title: Significant rising trend that holds across date ranges
verdict.text: Over 1981-2025 the series changed by +0.22 g/kg per decade. Both significance tests agree after allowing for month-to-month persistence, and 96% of all date windows of 15+ years point the same way.

crosscheck.label: No second dataset checked
crosscheck.text: This result has not been compared with an independent dataset. It describes this dataset; whether another record would show the same is not known.

source.kind: Reanalysis: a global model constrained by satellite and ground observations. Values are model-based estimates, not direct instrument readings.
source.caveat: MERRA-2 is a reanalysis: a model constrained by satellite and ground observations, not a direct measurement. Changes in the observing system over time (new satellites, fewer rain gauges) can create or hide trends, especially for precipitation and soil wetness. Check important results against an independent dataset.
